baseline_models.focus_anchor: كِتَابَ at word 3, أَبْرَارِ at word 4, and عِلِّيِّينَ at word 6.
baseline_models.mechanism: A durable writing preserves the deeds of people whose truth makes word and act hold, while the final locative places that record on a genuinely elevated plane.

activation_trace.role: Joining letters into a written object supplies a durable textual carrier for the record.
Truth that makes word or deed hold identifies the recorded people through performative integrity.
Rising and height give the record an elevated placement rather than an ordinary location.

changed_reading.before: A book belonging to good people is kept somewhere high.
changed_reading.after: A durable record of acts that hold true is itself established on an elevated plane.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construct كِتَابَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ and the emphatic لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Kitab can fix a binding judgment, birr can range across expansive obedience, and height can be rank; together they make the clause an authoritative assignment of honored standing, not merely a storage report.

activation_trace.role: Inscription as binding decree supplies the record with adjudicative force.
Expansive righteousness supplies the broad conduct on which the judgment bears.
Nobility and high rank turn vertical language into conferred standing.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports the location of the righteous person's file.
changed_reading.after: The verse ratifies expansive obedience as an honored rank through a binding record.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: كِتَابَ as register, ٱلْأَبْرَارِ as a relational plural, and عِلِّيِّينَ as high standing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can name a roster rather than only a dossier: acts of maintained connection define a company into which names are entered and thereby counted among the elevated.

activation_trace.role: Entering a name into a roll or company supplies the enrollment mechanism.
Dutiful connection against estrangement makes membership relational rather than atomized.
High rank supplies the standing of the company into which the names are entered.

changed_reading.before: Each righteous person has an individual record stored above.
changed_reading.after: The righteous are enrolled as a connected elevated company, so the book also functions as a roster of belonging.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening exchange makes kitab behave as a balancing ledger: measured intake, demanded completeness, deficient outflow, just weight, and visible inscription become operations by which truthful conduct is fixed without remainder.

activation_trace.role: Binding inscription lets the focus book close an account with enforceable force.
Truth that makes an act hold supplies the positive standard against manipulated exchange.
Measuring food supplies the concrete ledger operation from which exact accounting is inferred.
Completion without deficiency supplies the standard of a fully settled entry.
The scale of justice supplies calibration between what is taken and what is given.
Shorting measure or balance supplies the precise distortion that the righteous ledger excludes.
A marked line in a book or register makes the resulting account fixed and inspectable.

structural_cues: 83:1 supplies the branchless under-measure cue, and 83:2-3 reverse receiver and giver around completion and imposed loss.
83:7-9 and 83:18-20 repeat the book-in-realm formula, with the first book explicitly marked.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measure, completeness, deficient balance, and a marked book; I infer that these operations specify how the focus kitab accounts, while the live alternative is that they remain only the moral occasion surrounding an otherwise generic record.

changed_reading.before: The book is an unspecified record of righteous people.
changed_reading.after: The book is an exact counter-ledger that preserves full measure, exposes asymmetry, and closes truthful acts without loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired records occupy opposed access regimes: one is figured by confinement and blocked arrival, while the focus record is high, present to witnesses, and associated with privileged nearness. Location therefore also governs custody and access.

activation_trace.role: The written record supplies the object whose custody and accessibility are contrasted.
The upper side supplies a spatially open counter-position to confinement below.
Confinement in a holding place supplies the negative archive's mode of custody.
Prevention of access turns the negative side's placement into relational exclusion.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies the positive archive's open attestation.
The privileged nearness of an inner circle supplies authorized access to the high record.

structural_cues: 83:7-9 and 83:18-20 mirror record, realm, question, and marked-book syntax.
The movement from denied access in 83:15 to witnessed nearness in 83:21 straddles the focus declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prison, blocked access, witnessing, and nearness; I infer that the two locatives classify regimes of custody and access as well as places, while a strictly geographic contrast remains live.

changed_reading.before: Illiyyin is simply the high place where the record sits.
changed_reading.after: Illiyyin is also an open high archive or court in which the record is present to authorized witnesses, opposite a confining and inaccessible register.

context_deltas.mechanism: Marking, knowledgeable witness, recognition by traces, visible radiance, and sealing form an authentication chain. The binding focus record becomes a verdict whose validity is inspectable and whose effect appears on its subjects.

activation_trace.role: Binding inscription supplies the verdict-like force that the later signs authenticate.
High rank supplies the public status certified by the record.
A marked line in a register supplies a resolvable documentary mark.
Testimony that clarifies from knowledge supplies evidentiary confirmation.
Recognition through a trace or sign makes the verdict legible in its human result.
Visible brightness supplies the manifest effect by which the record's subjects are recognized.
Stamping with a seal and its impression supplies an analogical mark of authenticity.

structural_cues: 83:20-21 places the marked book immediately beside witness.
83:24 makes delight recognizable on faces, and 83:25-26 repeats sealing in the reward sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a marked register, knowledgeable witness, recognizable effects, and a sealed drink; I infer a documentary authentication chain, especially by analogy from the drink's seal, while the live alternative keeps sealing entirely within beverage imagery.

changed_reading.before: The record is a private divine file whose elevation is enough.
changed_reading.after: The elevated record is an authenticated public verdict, marked, witnessed, and made recognizable in the people it certifies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The register branch of kitab is activated as an admission and allotment roll: it enrolls a high company whose members gain privileged nearness, a fitting dwelling, an apportioned channel of drink, and access to what souls compete for.

activation_trace.role: Enrollment in a register or company supplies the admission instrument.
High rank supplies the status into which the righteous are admitted.
The favored inner circle supplies the community to which elevated enrollment grants access.
A fitting and pleasant dwelling supplies the settled benefit attached to membership.
An allotted share of watering and its channel supplies a concrete entitlement flowing from enrollment.
A precious object for which souls compete supplies the scarce good allocated to the enrolled company.

structural_cues: Witness by the near ones in 83:21 is followed by the righteous group's state and consumption in 83:22-28.
The imperatival competition in 83:26 makes access to the reward socially selective rather than merely descriptive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies enrollment, favored nearness, a fitting abode, a drink-share, and a coveted good; I infer that the record functions as a credential and allotment roll, while the live alternative treats all benefits as consequences not encoded by the book.

changed_reading.before: The book records an already defined moral class.
changed_reading.after: The book also enrolls that class and carries entitlement to nearness, residence, and an apportioned share of the high reward.

context_deltas.mechanism: Kitab's joining branch allows the record to accumulate enacted gains one by one, while the final recompense branch sends what was assembled back to its doer. The book is therefore not passive storage but a causal return circuit.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies the record's cumulative assembly of acts.
A deed that holds true supplies the kind of durable unit assembled into the righteous account.
Acquiring gain supplies the causal input that accrues to a person.
The return of an act's recompense to its worker supplies the circuit's backward delivery.
Bringing an act into being supplies the concrete event whose return the record mediates.

structural_cues: 83:14 makes what people acquire produce a covering effect upon them.
83:36 closes the surah by asking whether people received a return for what they kept doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accumulated acquisition, enacted work, and recompense returning to the worker; I infer that kitab mediates this causal loop, while the alternative is a simpler archive that only reports a return determined elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: The book statically stores completed deeds.
changed_reading.after: The book joins deeds into an operative account through which what a person enacts returns to that person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated vertical root in the focus is reactivated by an elevated source, mixture, flowing spring, and drink-share. Illiyyin can be carried as a headwater image: the high domain is generative, feeding the reward below rather than merely shelving a record.

activation_trace.role: Rising and elevation supply the vertical source position to which the flow is attached.
Mixing one substance with another requires an incoming component and supplies the flow relation.
Height and elevation supply the named mixture with an explicitly high source image.
A source of running water supplies the headwater from which the reward can proceed.
A share of water supplies the downstream reception of what issues from the high source.

structural_cues: 83:27 says the drink's mixture is from Tasnim, then 83:28 apposes a spring consumed by the near ones.
The reward sequence moves from sealed vessel to mixture, source, and direct drinking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies height, mixture from that height, a running spring, and a drink-share; I infer a downward hydraulic arrow that makes the high realm generative, while the alternative reads Tasnim only as a name or rank without spatial flow.

changed_reading.before: Illiyyin is a static upper shelf for the righteous record.
changed_reading.after: Illiyyin can also image the elevated headwater of reward, so the record is placed at a source from which the righteous share flows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus roots already permit prevailing and high rank; the later doubled reversal, exchanged laughter, and returned recompense make that elevation a public overturning of social judgment rather than private prestige.

activation_trace.role: Overcoming and rising supply a latent victorious edge within the designation of the righteous.
Prevailing and gaining mastery turn height into reversal of a prior hierarchy.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the explicit reversal mechanism repeated within the verse.
Joy or derision visibly expressed in laughter supplies the first public status judgment.
The same visible laughter transferred to the other group supplies the enacted inversion.
Recompense returning to the worker closes the reversal as a returned consequence rather than arbitrary triumph.

structural_cues: 83:29 and 83:34 mirror the same from-group and laughter construction with subject and object reversed.
83:23 and 83:35 repeat the couch-and-looking scene around that social exchange.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical reversal, exchanged laughter, repeated looking, and recompense returning to its doer; I infer that Illiyyin names public vindication and reordered standing, while the alternative treats reversal as a later consequence unrelated to the focus noun's force.

changed_reading.before: High rank is a static honor possessed by the righteous.
changed_reading.after: Their recorded highness is public vindication: a false social hierarchy is overturned and its judgment returns upon its makers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the locative grammar more readily suggests a containing realm, but it remains anchored by the focus branch that explicitly includes a title at the top of writing and by the written-book branch; downstream prose should present it only as a docket or typographic activation, not as a replacement gloss for Illiyyin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The direct adjacency of كِتَابَ and عِلِّيِّينَ in 83:18.

activation_trace.role: A written book supplies the surface on which a heading or classification can stand.
What is placed above, including the title at a writing's top, supplies the superscription image.
A marked line in a register keeps the superscription image document-grounded after context arrives.

changed_reading.before: Illiyyin only names the container in which the book is kept.
changed_reading.after: Illiyyin flickers as the book's upper heading or top-tier docket classification as well as its realm.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The manumission branch is form-distant from ordinary kitab here and the verse states no contract, so this cannot be asserted as lexical sense; it remains worth carrying because that branch is directly focus-anchored and the mirrored opposing register is explicitly activated by imprisonment. Render it as a liberation-contract analogy only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كِتَابَ at word 3 and its placement in elevated عِلِّيِّينَ at word 6.

activation_trace.role: A contracted writing that culminates in manumission supplies the latent liberation instrument.
Rising from a lower condition supplies the contract's direction of release.
Confinement in a prison supplies the opposing condition from which the focus book analogically releases.

changed_reading.before: The righteous record merely documents their status.
changed_reading.after: At the image level, the record can resemble a completed liberation contract whose opposite is the imprisoning register.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading the grain branch into al-abrar is materially surprising and must not be offered as its contextual lexical meaning; it remains anchored in the focus root inventory and is specifically awakened by food-measure and completion language. Render it as a harvest analogy in which deeds are kernels, not as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْأَبْرَارِ at word 4 beside كِتَابَ at word 3.

activation_trace.role: Grain and wheat supply the kernel material for a deliberately contained harvest image.
Joining one thing to another gathers the separate kernels into a single record-harvest.
Measuring food activates the grain branch as something received by exact measure.
Completion without deficiency makes the gathered harvest a full rather than short measure.

changed_reading.before: The book is an abstract moral dossier.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, it is a full-measured harvest assembled kernel by kernel from deeds that were not shorted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activating increase branch comes from the packet's non-dominant split mapping of context ر ب ب to root_000537, so it is too distant to identify the surface رَبّ with usury; it remains valid as a contrastive trigger because exploitative increase, just measure, focus truthfulness, and ambiguous highness visibly cohere. Render it as a warning that not every rise is Illiyyin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The combination of truthful ٱلْأَبْرَارِ and potentially domineering highness in عِلِّيِّينَ.

activation_trace.role: Truth that makes conduct hold supplies the criterion for legitimate elevation.
Haughty domination supplies the morally dangerous alternative latent within highness.
The scale of justice supplies the test that distinguishes ratified rank from predatory gain.
Increase through usurious dealing supplies the non-dominant split-root image of self-serving ascent.

changed_reading.before: All upwardness in the focus is automatically positive.
changed_reading.after: Illiyyin becomes discriminated elevation: highness ratified by truthful measure, not superiority manufactured through exploitative increase.

strongest_changes: The generic book became an exact counter-ledger and causal return circuit for measured deeds.
Being in Illiyyin became a regime of witnessed access and authenticated standing, not only a coordinate.
Enrollment, entitlement, generative height, and public reversal remain distinct coexisting functions of the same focus construction.
summary.what_was_special: The mirrored record formulas and the focus inventories allowed legal, spatial, documentary, social, hydraulic, and reversal mechanisms to coexist without forcing one final referent for Illiyyin; the odd branches added controlled images rather than being filtered out.
remaining_uncertainties: Illiyyin may primarily be a place, a register name, a ranked company, or a high source; the packet activates all four without resolving them.
The seal-to-document authentication move is analogical because the contextual seal belongs directly to the drink.
The superscription, manumission, grain, and non-dominant increase readings should remain explicitly exploratory and must not be promoted into lexical glosses.
